scheme_name: Mukhya Mantri Sarvajan Uchcha Shiksha Chhatravriti Yojana
other_conditions: The applicant must be enrolled in IITs, IIMs, NITs, AIIMS or other national institutions listed under the scheme
The applicant must not be availing any other government scholarship for the same course
The applicant must maintain academic performance as required for renewal of the scholarship
An employee pursuing full‑time studies while on leave without pay for the entire course duration is eligible
Students studying outside Rajasthan in the listed national institutions are eligible
benefits_summary: Provides 50% reimbursement of non‑refundable institutional fees, transferred directly to the student’s bank account annually.
